annotations.title: Solana Token Risk: Rug Pull & Scam Token Check (mint/freeze authority, holder concentration)

description: Solana token risk scan: rug pull and scam token check. Use when buying, accepting or listing a token. Input: mint. Output: JSON riskLevel (unknown if a check failed) + signals: mint authority, freeze authority (can freeze/blacklist), permanent delegate, transfer hook/fee, default-frozen, Token-2022 mutable metadata, top-10 share; pump.fun curve %/PumpSwap LP burn, dev %. No sell simulation; not an audit. Use instead: base_token_risk for ERC-20 tokens; token_report for a full brief with liquidity and sanctions; sol_token_info for basics only. Example: ?mint=EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v Price: $0.009 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.

mint.description: Token mint address on Solana mainnet (base58, 32 bytes). Bad input → 400, not a mint → 422 (not charged)
